chunks.area: site/docs.html — Worktrees and PRs: the Environment-panel correction
chunks.rationale: Read this first: it is the only hunk that fixes a statement that was actively WRONG on the public site, rather than adding something missing. Since #569 the worktree diff is a center pane behind Thread | Git tabs (changesOpen in src/App.tsx), not a card in the right-hand Environment panel. Check that the rewritten sentence also gets the residual Environment-panel controls right, because #512 moved Start Dev / Fork / Handoff off the thread header.
risks: If the sentence still implies the diff lives in the right rail, the page is wrong in a way a reader cannot detect without opening the app.

chunks.area: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Sidebar ordering and settle model (rewritten section)
chunks.rationale: Second, because it corrects the same class of error one layer down and was the trap in this change. The section previously documented partitionSidebar's precedence (snoozed > pinned > settled > attention) and a global settled tail. Sidebar.tsx line 31 imports only buildFlatSidebar: a T3-flat list where pinned is its own top block and there are no project group headers. partitionSidebar survives only as a test-referenced shadow. Verify the rewrite names buildFlatSidebar, and that the data attributes and localStorage keys it cites (sidebar:snoozedOpen, sidebar:settledOpen, sidebar:projectScope, data-pinned-divider) are the live ones.
risks: The retired selectors (data-later-shelf, data-pinned-section, coder.sidebar.settledCollapsed) must be described as retired, not current — a reader writing a test off a retired selector gets a silently-passing no-op.
The worker was briefed with the stale #567 model and corrected it from source; the correction is the part most worth re-reading.

chunks.area: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — new subsystem sections (Ask mode, Post-merge verification, Quota wait, Code index, Divergence)
chunks.rationale: Third: pure additions, no prior text to contradict. These are engineering-reference prose, so the failure mode is a plausible-sounding invented symbol rather than a wrong sentence. All 214 backticked identifiers in the diff were grepped back to a real symbol or file before merge; re-check any you change.
risks: Ask mode's guarantee is ordering-dependent: startRun must intercept thread.ask === true BEFORE assertUnderDailyBudget and worktree materialization. If that ordering claim is ever wrong the section reads as a safety promise the code does not keep.

chunks.area: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md + site/docs.html — Memory and Spec mode extensions
chunks.rationale: Fourth: edits folded into existing sections rather than new ones, so read them in place to confirm they inherit the surrounding register and do not repeat what the paragraph above already said. Covers provenance tiers (src/provenance.ts), the config doctor (electron/configDoctor.js), and the tasks.md dispatch DAG (needs: syntax, electron/specTasks.js).
risks: Provenance has exactly four surfaced tiers (repo, memory, issues, and the ungrounded 'model prior knowledge' tag above PRIOR_MIN_CHARS). Adding a fifth from the internal collector would describe a badge the UI never renders.

chunks.rationale: Last, and deliberately: it is the shortest chunk (+11 net) and the one with the least room to be wrong, because each addition is a clause folded into an existing bullet. Read it as a stranger arriving from GitHub search and ask whether the added clauses earn their line in a file that is intentionally tight.
risks: Numbers here age: the 400-line PR cap and the 24h post-merge delay are defaults (src/prUi.ts:57, electron/postmerge.js:23) and are stated as defaults. If either becomes configurable-by-default the README is the copy most likely to be forgotten.

Documentation-only change: no test covers whether any sentence is true, so the only gate is that each claim was traced to source. Every claim in this diff was checked against the file it names before merge.

site/docs.html is hand-written static HTML with a hand-maintained nav. A new h2 without its nav link, or an unbalanced tag, breaks the published page silently — there is no build step or validator in CI for site/.

The three chunks were written by parallel workers that could not see each other. README, site/docs.html and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md may now describe the same feature in three slightly different vocabularies; the risk is drift in naming, not contradiction.
